title: Colour-correct the textures
author: claude
summary: The oak, paint, walnut, linen, marble and other textures were colour-matched to the reference.
what: A script colour-corrects the room's textures and also generates the rug tile, the rug fuzz and the fig leaf pictures.
why: Downloaded textures rarely match the look of the reference images as they are.
how: One script (`prepare_textures.py`) grades the oak, paint, walnut, linen, marble and others, and makes the generated pictures.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
